channel.title: New York Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New York Daily News (nydailynews.com)

item.title: Alysa Liu dazzles to win figure skating gold, ending a 24-year Olympic drought for US women
item.description: Alysa Liu had just delivered a near-flawless Olympic free skate on Thursday night.

item.title: Pistons’ JB Bickerstaff: Beating Knicks now will matter later, despite playoff loss last season
item.description: Detroit Pistons head coach JB Bickerstaff isn’t interested in letting last year’s first-round playoff exit erase what his team has done to the Knicks across the past two regular seasons.

item.title: Budget shortfall may close the book on Mamdani’s library funding promise
item.description: After vowing on the campaign trail to give libraries up to 0.5% of the city’s budget, Mayor Mamdani in his preliminary spending plan included a $30 million cut.

item.title: Rookies tested as Nets fall to Cavaliers, 112-84
item.description: Cleveland offered the benchmark Thursday night, and the Nets quickly saw the difference.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ and ‘Euphoria’ star, has died at 53
item.description: Eric Dane, the actor known for “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria,” has died at 53 due to ALS. His representatives say he died on Thursday afternoon. His family says he spent his final days with loved ones.

item.title: Savannah Chrisley gets shut down on ‘The View’ for insisting Trump isn’t racist
item.description: The stars of “The View” got into a heated debate with guest host Savannah Chrisley after she insisted on Thursday that President Trump is not a racist.

item.title: Pistons, Cade Cunningham continue dominance over Knicks to complete regular-season sweep
item.description: The Knicks were again outclassed by the NBA-best Pistons in Thursday night’s 126-111 loss at Madison Square Garden.

item.title: Kristian Winfield: Knicks embarrassing loss to Pistons underscores all gone wrong
item.description: This is not a game the Knicks should have lost. It's certainly not a game they should have lost by double digits.

item.title: Knicks freeze-out Karl-Anthony Towns vs. center-less Pistons: ‘It’s our offense’
item.description: The Knicks didn't exploit their biggest mismatch until it was too late.

item.title: Asking Eric: Couple’s happy marriage breaks down over laundry
item.description: Dear Eric: My wife and I have been married for more than 40 years. She’s great. But a reoccurring point of friction and, really, anger on my part is over the dishwashing and laundry at our house. She’ll let them accumulate beyond what I can stand.
